oracle: On-disk set of the standalone output: every package directory under .next/standalone/node_modules.
notes: Only .next/standalone/ is kept, with an empty server.js where Next.js wrote the real one (at runtime it sets __NEXT_PRIVATE_STANDALONE_CONFIG). debug 4.3.7 is a declared production dependency imported from app/api/hello/route.js; Next.js bundles it into .next/server/chunks, so it is absent from the standalone node_modules and the walk must report `partial`. Other declared dependencies that are not traced and so do not resolve: next -> postcss, caniuse-lite, baseline-browser-mapping; @swc/helpers -> tslib; react-dom -> scheduler. Next.js also ships vendored copies under node_modules/next/dist/compiled/<name>/package.json (some with a name, such as debug); they are not in a node_modules folder and are not packages of the app. sharp's platform packages (@img/sharp-linux-<arch>, @img/sharp-libvips-linux-<arch>) depend on the build machine's architecture. Installed on Linux aarch64 in Docker.
